sdk_targets.min_sdk_rationale: Matches mobile/shared/build.gradle.kts baseline (Android 8.0 Oreo). Covers required Java 8 desugaring and spatial math.

reference_hardware.role: Real-world physical hardware performance validation baseline

insets_rules: WindowInsets.safeDrawing for top status bar and bottom navigation gesture bars
WindowInsets.ime for keyboard animations and search filters
Zero artificial black bars or letterboxing

predictive_back_policy.compose_api: PredictiveBackHandler for modal bottom sheets and nested backstacks

window_size_classes.compact: < 600dp (standard smartphones): Bottom Navigation Bar, single-column feed
window_size_classes.medium: 600dp - 840dp (foldables, small tablets): Navigation Rail, list-detail pane
window_size_classes.expanded: > 840dp (tablets, desktops): Persistent Navigation Rail, dual-pane simultaneous view

color_and_theme_strategy.design_system: Odisha Cultural Atlas branded palette (Sandstone #B87B22 / #D4A373, Charcoal #0A0F1D / #0D1117, Forest #1F3A2B / #34D399, Warm Sand #F9F6F0)
color_and_theme_strategy.dynamic_color_policy: Branded theme is authoritative. Dynamic Color (Material You) may be optionally enabled by user preference, but Atlas cultural pins and truth badges remain branded.

location_and_permissions.rule: Never ask for location at app launch. Prompt only when user taps 'Near Me' or requests transit first-mile guidance.
